goal: Keep each failed physical case and its reached-stage timing visible before a later job timeout.
procedure: Read actual completed core and cancelled native logs. Preserve the core result of 29 passing cases and one comparison response-budget failure. Recognize that default unittest deferred native error tracebacks until a final summary that the one-hour cancellation prevented. Add a result class that emits each error or failure immediately, records completion duration, and enables periodic stack-only diagnostics while a case is running. Keep all discovered cases and budgets unchanged. Smoke-check an intentional failure followed by a case that requires the earlier failure already to be in the stream; verify both watchdog timers are cleaned and ordinary failed-suite status remains. Add fixed-label milestone timing to the chronological integration fixture only after each actual stage has succeeded.
authority: Runner diagnostics qualify neither learned behavior nor a passing engine gate. Original owner consent, selected-engine state, source closure and independent producer qualification retain authority.
validation: Controlled reporting check confirms the intentional failure appears before the later test, both completed cases report timings and both stack timers are cancelled. Exhaustive discovery still finds 43 physical tests with four in history. At implementation, the published core run passed 29 of 30 tests; comparison statuses were budget_exceeded. The earlier native job was cancelled before its final summary; restart gates were not reached. Optimized physical results remain pending.
failure_or_lesson: A later slow case can erase actionable evidence from earlier failed cases when diagnostics are deferred until suite completion. Preserve immediate diagnostics without inventing a completed-stage receipt or extending latency budgets.
